_README: Manual ESPN athlete id -> nba_api player id overrides. Highest priority in
id_map.py; use it when name matching picks the wrong player or misses one
you care about. Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored.
Why this matters: nba_api's bundled static player list only changes when the
package is released, so each new rookie class is missing until then. As those
rookies reach 10 games the build's 95% id-match gate fails (2026-11-17).
